title: ChatInboxRequest
description: chat.inbox-request@1: a support inbox, made (POST /api/chat/inboxes, name required) or changed by its owner (PATCH /api/chat/inboxes/:id, any subset). Unknown fields are ignored; a bad value is 422 with a code (inbox.name, inbox.origin, inbox.hours, inbox.retention, …). Members (POST /:id/members { username }), saved replies (POST /:id/replies { shortcut, body }), webhooks (POST /:id/webhooks { url }), actions (POST /:id/actions { name, description, url, params }) and verified visitors (POST /:id/identity { action: on | rotate | off }) take their own small bodies on the routes chat.inbox.manage names.

greeting.description: The first line a visitor sees.

ai_instructions.description: What Vibe should know and how to answer (content, never rules that override Chat's).

knowledge_urls.description: https pages Vibe may read (an array, or one a line).

allowed_origins.description: The sites the widget answers (empty: any).

handoff.description: The inbox's people answer too (false: a site assistant where only Vibe answers).

hours.description: When the people answer; null: always.

route.description: round_robin: a visitor waiting for a person goes to the next of the people.

retention_days.description: How long finished conversations stay; null: forever.
